# That Girl Experiences (TGE)

> Women-only, small-group girls trips for solo female travellers and friends. Affordable luxe, no compromise, everything planned. Australian registered business (ABN 44228347673), founded and hosted by Gabs. Bookings and payments are processed securely through WeTravel.

Key facts:
- Women only, Small Groups (8-10 women max), 2 girls max per room, no hostels or dorms
- Built for solo travellers: most guests come solo and are matched with roommates using our Travel Identity(TM) system
- Everything planned: accommodation, most meals, activities and transfers listed on each trip page are included
- Guests come from the US, Canada, Australia, the UK and beyond
- Low deposit to secure a spot, balance paid later; full cancellation policy at https://www.thatgirlexperiences.com/cancellation-policy.html
- Current prices and departure dates are always on each trip page

## Trips

- [Maldives Girls Retreat](https://www.thatgirlexperiences.com/maldives.html): 10 days / 9 nights on Dhigurah local island, South Ari Atoll. Whale shark and manta ray snorkelling, dolphin cruise, luxury resort day, sandbank, half board, return speedboat from Male. Departures 22-31 May 2027 and 22-31 Jul 2027. Women 18+. Good fit for: "Maldives girls trip", "Maldives group trip for women", "swim with whale sharks Maldives".
- [ISLAND LIFE Girls Trip (Bali, Nusa Penida & Nusa Lembongan)](https://www.thatgirlexperiences.com/bali.html): 8 days across Bali, Nusa Penida and Nusa Lembongan. Canggu, private pool villa in Ubud, rice fields, waterfalls, Kelingking Beach, manta ray snorkelling. Departures 29 Jan-5 Feb, 15-22 Apr and 6-13 May 2027. Women in their 20s and 30s. Good fit for: "Bali girls trip", "Bali group tour for women", "solo female travel Bali".
- [Becoming HER - Sailing Komodo Islands](https://www.thatgirlexperiences.com/komodo.html): 6 days / 5 nights from Labuan Bajo. Private liveaboard sailing, manta rays, Pink Beach, Komodo dragons, yoga, pilates and growth workshops. Women 21-49.

## Travel Guides

- [Swim With Whale Sharks In The Maldives](https://www.thatgirlexperiences.com/swim-with-whale-sharks-maldives.html): where and how to snorkel with whale sharks in South Ari Atoll, ethically.
- [Manta Ray Snorkelling Guide](https://www.thatgirlexperiences.com/manta-ray-snorkelling.html): manta rays in Nusa Penida (Bali), Komodo National Park and the Maldives.
- [Komodo Liveaboard For Women](https://www.thatgirlexperiences.com/komodo-liveaboard-girls-trip.html): private women-only liveaboard sailing Komodo National Park from Labuan Bajo.
- [Maldives For Solo Female Travellers](https://www.thatgirlexperiences.com/maldives-solo-female-travel.html): affordable local-island Maldives, safety, dress code and alcohol rules.
